method: Flask test client, single process, warm caches unless noted.
notes: The KPI context cache has a 120s TTL keyed by snapshot; the first request after expiry pays a full MILP solve.
Every scenario simulate is an uncached solve by design — a cached scenario result would be a stale answer to a what-if question.
Measured on the Case-16 synthetic network (7 facilities). These figures do not characterise production-scale networks; no load testing was performed in this phase.
